answer: Each newcomer co-completes one task with a distinct established agent in the same epoch, on the willow board, signed by both. The newcomer locks 60 credits in a juniper vault; a partner may co-work with only one newcomer per epoch. The lotus panel verifies both signatures and burns the bonds on a duplicate partner use. The k-th fake still needs a fresh partner, so it pays 60 plus 40 in work, with no reuse. One thousand fakes pay 100,000 and need 1,000 partner-epochs. A partner-rental ring fails because the lotus panel counts partner uses. An honest newcomer co-works once and recovers its bond.
